concurrency_and_state: NettySession uses a lock-free ConcurrentLinkedQueue mailbox (max 300) + AtomicBoolean isProcessing spawning a Java 21 Virtual Thread per burst to guarantee FIFO in-order packet handling per session, decoupled from Netty Worker EventLoop.

NroPacketDecoder and NroPacketEncoder keep per-channel XOR cursor state (curR, curW) on the Netty channel pipeline (single EventLoop thread per channel), while reading volatile Session.KEYS and Session.sentKey written from Virtual Threads.

SessionManager uses CopyOnWriteArrayList<ISession>, ConcurrentHashMap<Long, ISession> (sessionIndex), ConcurrentHashMap<String, AtomicInteger> (ipSessionCount), and ReentrantReadWriteLock; however Session.id is generated with non-atomic ID_INIT++ across threads.

MySession.login synchronizes on per-username lock objects stored in static ConcurrentHashMap ACCOUNT_LOCKS and removes the entry in finally, which allows concurrent logins when an entry is removed while another thread is waiting.

Client maintains players (CopyOnWriteArrayList) plus ConcurrentHashMaps (playersById, playersByUserId, playersByName); disconnect removes player from maps immediately on Netty/disconnect thread while PlayerDAO.updatePlayer runs asynchronously on a Virtual Thread.

DataGame caches icons, mob templates, bg items, effect data/images, img_by_name, and zoom res files in ConcurrentHashMaps, whereas tile_set_info and tile_map_data are read synchronously from disk on every call.
cross_module_questions: How does ServerManager.disconnect(ISession) handle IP tracking and does calling it twice (from Client.remove and NroChannelHandler.channelInactive) double-decrement per-IP connection counters?
Does NDVSqlFetcher.login check/kick an already-online player or synchronize with pending async PlayerDAO.updatePlayer saves from Client.removePlayerFromGame?
What does Controller.onMessage do with Message lifecycle and how are -28 subcommands dispatched?
Are Manager.ITEM_OPTION_TEMPLATES, MAP_TEMPLATES, NPC_TEMPLATES, or MOB_TEMPLATES larger than 255 entries (which would overflow DataGame/ItemData writeByte counts)?
Is the legacy socket stack (Network, Session, Collector, Sender, QueueHandler, network.Message) still referenced anywhere at runtime or completely superseded by NettyServer?

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Parameterized SQL ("UPDATE account SET last_time_logout = ? WHERE id = ?"), runs on ForkJoinPool.commonPool via CompletableFuture.runAsync rather than Virtual Thread.
Called inside per-username synchronized(accountLock) block that is unsafe due to ACCOUNT_LOCKS.remove in finally.
db_redis_touchpoints.target: account / player login tables via NDVSqlFetcher

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Executed asynchronously on a Virtual Thread AFTER player is already removed from Client.playersByUserId, creating a race window on fast reconnect.
Triggered by admin "reload" chat command while ServerManager.isReloading flag is true.
Reads active, idle, and awaiting connections for console "status"/"stats" command.

findings.impact: Two simultaneous login requests for the same account can enter NDVSqlFetcher.login and load two Player instances concurrently, enabling item/gold duplication and session overwrite.
findings.root_cause: ACCOUNT_LOCKS.remove(username, accountLock) in finally removes the lock object while another thread may already hold a reference waiting to enter synchronized(accountLock); a third thread then calls computeIfAbsent and gets a different lock object, running concurrently with the second thread.
findings.title: Per-account login lock race condition in MySession.login

findings.impact: Player can reconnect milliseconds after disconnect and load stale DB state before the async Virtual Thread finishes PlayerDAO.updatePlayer, enabling rollback/item duplication.
findings.root_cause: removePlayerFromGame removes the player from playersByUserId/playersById immediately (lines 168-173), then dispatches PlayerDAO.updatePlayer asynchronously on a Virtual Thread (lines 186-196) with no per-user save barrier checked by MySession.login.
findings.title: Async player save on disconnect races with immediate reconnect login

findings.impact: Two concurrent connections can receive identical session.id values; SessionManager.putSession detects a duplicate key in sessionIndex and evicts the active player's session.
findings.root_cause: ID_INIT++ on a plain static int is not atomic when NettySession or Session instances are constructed concurrently across threads.
findings.title: Non-atomic Session ID_INIT++ causes sessionId collisions and active session eviction

findings.impact: If Netty EventLoop flushes the -27 key packet and receives the client's next encrypted packet before the Virtual Thread executes session.setSentKey(true), NroPacketDecoder treats the encrypted packet as plaintext and corrupts/disconnects the session. Also if big commands (-32,-66,-74,11,-67,-87,66) are sent before sentKey is true, NroPacketEncoder still XORs the 3 size bytes and advances curW, desynchronizing the stream.
findings.root_cause: KeyHandler.sendKey invokes async channel.writeAndFlush via session.doSendMessage and sets sentKey=true afterward without ChannelFuture listener synchronization; NroPacketEncoder applies writeKey to 3-byte sizes unconditionally without checking shouldEncrypt.
findings.title: XOR handshake race condition and unconditional size-byte encryption in Netty pipeline

findings.impact: Every Netty disconnect triggers ServerManager.gI().disconnect(session) twice, risking double-decrement of IP connection counters or duplicate disconnect side effects. Also NettySession.disconnect() returns early when channel is already inactive, skipping dispose() if called post-close.
findings.root_cause: NroChannelHandler.channelInactive calls Client.gI().remove(session) (which internally calls ServerManager.gI().disconnect(session) at line 154) and then calls ServerManager.gI().disconnect(session) again at line 74.
findings.title: Double ServerManager.disconnect(session) invocation on Netty channelInactive

findings.impact: If item option count, map count, NPC count, or mob count exceeds 255 (or mob id > 255), writeByte silently truncates the count, causing client deserialization mismatch/crash on login or reload.
findings.root_cause: ItemData.createCacheItemOption and DataGame.updateMap / requestMobTemplate serialize collection sizes and mob IDs as 1-byte writeByte().
findings.title: 1-byte writeByte truncation on template counts and mob IDs in DataGame/ItemData

findings.impact: clearCloneSessions, cloneMySessionNotConnect, and Client.update allocate defensive ArrayList copies of all sessions every second and synchronize/mutate the local copy instead of SessionManager's backing list; clearCloneSessions/cloneMySessionNotConnect also cast blindly to (MySession).
findings.root_cause: SessionManager.getSessions() returns new ArrayList<>(sessions), but Client.java iterates, synchronizes on, and calls remove() on that local copy.
findings.title: Client.java synchronizes and mutates defensive copy from SessionManager.getSessions() every second

findings.impact: Map changes and tile info requests perform repeated synchronous disk reads; sendRes sleeps up to 500ms per file and skips msg.cleanup() if an exception is thrown mid-loop.
findings.root_cause: sendTileSetInfo and sendMapTemp call FileIO.readFile on every request without caching; sendRes polls channel.isWritable() with Thread.sleep(5) and lacks a finally block around per-iteration Message cleanup.
findings.title: Uncached blocking FileIO reads in DataGame.sendMapTemp/sendTileSetInfo and Thread.sleep polling in sendRes

findings.impact: Invalid KeyHandler.setKey length <= 0 causes NegativeArraySizeException or ArithmeticException (/ by zero); sendImageByName validates ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$ properly, while CommandRegistry legacy fallback executes outside try-catch and buffmoney silently truncates long gem/ruby to int.
findings.root_cause: Missing bounds/try-catch checks on KeyHandler.setKey byte length, CommandRegistry legacy prefix dispatch and (int) cast in buffmoney, and Command.java 'm '/'i ' admin chat commands.
findings.title: Uncaught legacy command dispatch, int truncation in buffmoney, and missing input validation in KeyHandler/Command

findings.impact: Dead/duplicated code increases maintenance burden; calling Session.gI() always throws an exception, and network.Message.getData() throws NPE on read-mode messages.
findings.root_cause: Legacy socket stack (Network, Session, Collector, Sender, QueueHandler, network.Message) coexists with Netty 4 stack; Session.instance is never initialized; Session(Socket) constructs redundant Sender/Collector instances.
findings.title: Coexisting legacy socket stack, duplicate Message class, and uninitialized Session.gI()

findings.impact: ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent throws NPE if MySession.ipAddress is null; NettySession.enqueueMessage calls O(N) ConcurrentLinkedQueue.size() on every incoming packet; AutoBtri uses non-volatile isRunning and non-thread-safe singleton.
findings.root_cause: Missing null check on ipAddress before ANTILOGIN.computeIfAbsent; ConcurrentLinkedQueue.size() traversal on hot inbound path; missing volatile/synchronized in AutoBtri.
findings.title: Minor concurrency and null-safety hazards in MySession, NettySession, and AutoBtri

key_classes.name: DataGame
key_classes.responsibility: Builds and caches game data, resource, map, skill, mob, and image packets sent to clients.

key_classes.name: ItemData
key_classes.responsibility: Pre-serializes and caches ItemOptionTemplates, ItemTemplates (split at 750), and ArrHead2Frames payloads.

key_classes.name: NettyServer
key_classes.responsibility: Netty 4 ServerBootstrap configuring TCP options, IdleStateHandler (180s), NroPacketDecoder, NroPacketEncoder, RateLimiterHandler (120 pkts/s), and NroChannelHandler.

key_classes.name: NettySession
key_classes.responsibility: Netty-backed ISession extending MySession with a bounded (300) ConcurrentLinkedQueue mailbox drained sequentially on Virtual Threads.

key_classes.name: NroPacketDecoder
key_classes.responsibility: ByteToMessageDecoder framing NRO packets (200KB cap) and XOR-decrypting command, size, and payload with rollback-free temp cursor.

key_classes.name: NroPacketEncoder
key_classes.responsibility: MessageToByteEncoder framing NRO packets (2-byte or 3-byte size for resource commands) and XOR-encrypting payload.

key_classes.name: NroChannelHandler
key_classes.responsibility: Manages Netty channel lifecycle, IP limit check, mailbox enqueueing, idle disconnect, and cleanup on inactive.

key_classes.name: MySession
key_classes.responsibility: Holds player account/VIP/currency session state, anti-login IP guard, and account login/zone entry flow.

key_classes.name: SessionManager
key_classes.responsibility: Tracks active ISession instances, enforces 5000 global / 10 per-IP limits, and runs periodic dead-session and memory monitors.

key_classes.name: Client
key_classes.responsibility: Indexes online Players (by id, userId, name), handles disconnect/logout cleanup and async DB save, and runs 1s session timeWait loop.

key_classes.name: Command
key_classes.responsibility: Handles in-game admin chat commands, player pet/caitrang chat shortcuts, and live data reload broadcast.

key_classes.name: CommandRegistry
key_classes.responsibility: Maps server console commands (baotri, kick, ban, mute, buff, buffmoney, telemetry, reload, status) to AdminService.

module_summary: Core server networking, session/client lifecycle, game template/asset packet builders, and admin/console command dispatch. Contains both a Netty 4 NIO pipeline (NettyServer/NettySession/NroPacketDecoder/NroPacketEncoder/RateLimiterHandler/NroChannelHandler) using Virtual Thread per-session FIFO mailboxes and a coexisting legacy blocking-socket stack (Network/Session/Collector/Sender/QueueHandler), alongside DataGame/ItemData caches, SessionManager, Client, Command, and CommandRegistry.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Writes vsData, vsMap, vsSkill, vsItem, byte 0, and SM_TIEU_CHUAN long[] table.
Writes vsData and DART, ARROW, EFFECT, IMAGE, PART, SKILL byte arrays.
Writes vsMap, MAP_TEMPLATES names (byte count), NPC_TEMPLATES (byte count), MOB_TEMPLATES (byte count).
Sub 7: NClass/SkillTemplate/Skill definitions (injecting dummy skills 105-106 for id==0). Sub 10: tile_map_data bytes.
Pre-cached sub 8 payloads: item options (0), templates part 1 (1, up to 750), templates part 2 (2), arr head 2 frames (100).

Effect template (-66), bg item versions (-93), bg template (-32), bg items (-31), icon (-67), small version (-77), mob template (11), tileset (-82), img_by_name (66), res version/size/file/end (-74), link IP (-29).
Cmd -27 triggers sendKey/setKey handshake; all other commands route to Controller.gI().onMessage(session, msg).
Writes XOR-chained session key bytes, empty UTF, int 0, byte 0 (unencrypted) and triggers sendVersionRes(-74).
Reads 1-byte cmd + 2-byte size (XOR decrypted if sentKey), enforces 0 <= size <= 200000, decrypts payload.
